snippet.title: Renard's Skin Care Routine - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🌸Itch page: https://accuratefox-games.itch.io/renards-skin-care-routine

Renard's Skin Care Routine is a fairly short, silly visual novel about Renard, a fox living in the outskirts of Ivisia, preparing for an April Fools Day they somehow managed to almost forget was coming.

Play around with 18 (19 if you count the choccy milk) skin care products over the course of the five days until April Fools, decide what pranks would be funniest, and side-eye Kettu from across the supermarket.

Maybe there'll be time for a quick game too... maybe.
